title: [GMCP 203.041.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Reliability, durability, recovery, backup, and offline operation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-041-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Crash-consistent journals and atomic state transitions recover tasks, approvals, registry snapshots, desired state and lifecycle operations without replaying side effects. Defined RPO/RTO targets are met under kill -9, power-loss simulation, corrupt/torn state, full disk and clock skew; backups are encrypted, versioned and restore-tested; and all declared local capabilities remain usable without network access. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
